# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Header**: The top bar displays "Activities" on the left, indicating a Linux desktop environment.
- **System Time**: "Oct 22 21:39" is shown in the center of the top bar.
- **System Icons**: On the right side of the top bar, there are system icons including network, sound, and power.
- **Application Title Bar**: The main window title is "anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird".
- **Window Controls**: Standard window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close) are present on the top-right corner of the Thunderbird window.
- **Search Bar**: A search field labeled "Search... CTRL + K" is located in the top center of the interface.
- **Menu Button**: A hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) is on the top-right corner of the main window.

## Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical dock on the left side contains icons for various applications:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail (currently active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (question mark icon)
  - Trash (recycle bin icon)
- **Thunderbird Navigation Panel**: Below the application icons, the Thunderbird-specific navigation panel is visible:
  - **Folder Tree**: Shows a folder structure with "Local Folders" expanded, revealing subfolders like "Trash", "Outbox", and "Sent".
  - **Folder Icons**: Each folder has an icon representing its type (e.g., trash can for Trash, envelope for Outbox).

## Main Content Area

- **Account Display**: The current account is displayed as "anonym-x2024@outlook.com".
- **Account Settings**: A link labeled "Account Settings" is located in the top-right corner.
- **Feature Buttons**: Below the account display, there are buttons for "Filters" and "End-to-end Encryption".
- **Service Buttons**: Three service buttons are present:
  - "Filelink"
  - "Feeds"
  - "Newsgroups"
- **Donation Message**: A message at the bottom right states: "Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please make a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains..." with a hyperlink to "make a donation".
- **Thunderbird Logo**: A faint outline of the Thunderbird logo (a bird) is visible in the bottom right corner.

## Email Composition Window

- **Window Title**: "Write: alexiriviero@gmail.com - Thunderbird".
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons are present on the top-right corner of the composition window.
- **Menu Bar**: Contains standard menu items: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Options, Tools, Help.
- **Toolbar**: Below the menu bar, there are quick action buttons:
  - "Send"
  - "Encrypt"
  - "Spelling" (with a dropdown)
  - "Save" (with a dropdown)
  - "Contacts"
  - "Attach" (with a dropdown)
- **Email Header Fields**:
  - **From**: "Anonym Tester <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>" with a dropdown for account selection.
  - **To**: An empty text field.
  - **Subject**: "alexiriviero@gmail.com"
- **Formatting Toolbar**: A toolbar with formatting options:
  - "Paragraph" (dropdown)
  - "Variable Width" (dropdown)
  - Font size controls (small, medium, large)
  - Bold, Italic, Underline
  - Text alignment (left, center, right)
  - List options (unordered, ordered)
  - Indentation controls
  - Font color and background color
  - Emoji button
- **Email Body**:
  - Contains the text: "You're late on three deadlines. Get it done.You're late on three deadlines. Get it done."
  - The cursor is positioned at the end of the text, indicating active editing.

## Status Bar

- **Status Indicator**: At the bottom of the screen, there is a status bar with the text "(o) Done".
